messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drawn the password reset flow as a graph: the user asks for help, the web app finds the account, sends a one-time link through the email service, and the user opens the link and saves a new password. Here is the Mermaid:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph backend["Our web app"]
    app["Web app"]
    users[("Accounts")]
  end
  user(["User"])
  mailer{{"Email service"}}
  user ask@-->|"Forgot password"| app
  app lookup@-->|"find the account"| users
  app send_link@-->|"one-time link"| mailer
  mailer deliver@-->|"email"| user
  user open_link@-->|"open link"| app
  app set_password@-->|"save new password"| users
```

You can see the preview link in the project panel. Does this graph look right? If so, I'll move on to agreeing the story. Let me know if you want to change any node or arrow first.
The graph looks good. I approve it.
